claims.subject: cn-generative-ai-interim-measures-2023

object.value: Measures do not apply to research and development of generative AI that does not provide services to the public in China

claims.statement: Article 2, third paragraph, of the Interim Measures provides that the Measures do not apply where industry organisations, enterprises, educational and research institutions and others research, develop or apply generative AI technology without providing generative AI services to the public within China.

time.note: Dated by the order issuing the Measures (Order No. 15 of 2023-07-10); in force from 2023-08-15 (dataset record cn-genai-measures-issued).

claims.qualification: States the text's scope exclusion only. Whether any named developer or service falls within the category is set aside.

evidence.passage: 未向境内公众提供生成式人工智能服务的，不适用本办法的规定
evidence.translation: [where they] do not provide generative AI services to the public within China, the provisions of these Measures do not apply
evidence.note: Checked in the gov.cn posting; the dataset source is the cac.gov.cn posting of the same Measures.

claims.briefQuestion: What does Article 2 of the 2023 Interim Measures say about generative AI research and development that is not offered to the public in China?

claims.subject: cn-generative-ai-interim-measures-2023

object.value: Providers to carry out pre-training and optimisation-training data processing lawfully, under listed rules

claims.statement: Article 7 of the Interim Measures requires generative AI service providers to carry out training-data processing activities such as pre-training and optimisation training in accordance with law and to comply with the rules it lists.

time.note: Dated by Order No. 15.

claims.qualification: States the duty the text places on "providers" as it defines them (Article 22). Whether any named developer or service falls within the category is set aside. Compliance is not recorded.

evidence.passage: 应当依法开展预训练、优化训练等训练数据处理活动
evidence.translation: shall carry out training-data processing activities such as pre-training and optimisation training in accordance with law

claims.subject: cn-generative-ai-interim-measures-2023

object.value: Use data and foundation models with lawful sources

claims.statement: Article 7, point (1), of the Interim Measures requires providers to use data and foundation models that have lawful sources.

time.note: Dated by Order No. 15.

claims.qualification: Whether any named developer or service falls within the category is set aside. The text does not define "lawful source".

evidence.passage: 使用具有合法来源的数据和基础模型
evidence.translation: use data and foundation models that have lawful sources

claims.subject: cn-generative-ai-interim-measures-2023

object.value: Training data: no infringement of IP; consent or other legal basis for personal information; measures to improve data quality

claims.statement: Article 7, points (2) to (4), of the Interim Measures require providers, in training-data processing, not to infringe others' intellectual property rights, to obtain consent or meet another legal ground where personal information is involved, and to take effective measures to improve training-data quality, including its truthfulness, accuracy, objectivity and diversity.

time.note: Dated by Order No. 15.

claims.qualification: Whether any named developer or service falls within the category is set aside.

evidence.passage: Points (2) to (4) require, respectively: no infringement of intellectual property rights others lawfully enjoy; personal consent or another situation provided by law where personal information is involved; and effective measures to improve training-data quality and its truthfulness, accuracy, objectivity and diversity.

claims.subject: cn-generative-ai-interim-measures-2023

object.value: Label generated content such as images and video under the Deep Synthesis Provisions

claims.statement: Article 12 of the Interim Measures requires providers to label generated content such as images and videos in accordance with the Provisions on the Administration of Deep Synthesis of Internet Information Services.

time.note: Dated by Order No. 15.

claims.qualification: Cross-reference only; the Deep Synthesis Provisions were not retrieved. The 2025 Labelling Measures (fl-cn-labelling-*) set later labelling rules. Whether any named developer or service falls within the category is set aside.

evidence.passage: Providers are to label generated content such as pictures and videos according to the Provisions on the Administration of Deep Synthesis of Internet Information Services (《互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定》).

claims.subject: cn-generative-ai-interim-measures-2023

object.value: On finding illegal content: stop generation and transmission, remove, rectify including by model optimisation training, and report

claims.statement: Article 14 of the Interim Measures requires a provider that discovers illegal content to stop its generation and transmission, remove it, rectify the problem by measures including model optimisation training, and report to the competent authorities.

time.note: Dated by Order No. 15.

claims.qualification: Whether any named developer or service falls within the category is set aside. The second paragraph (measures against users engaged in illegal activity) is not recorded.

evidence.passage: 采取模型优化训练等措施进行整改
evidence.translation: take measures such as model optimisation training to rectify [the matter]

evidence.locator: Article 14 (第十四条), first paragraph, remainder
evidence.passage: The paragraph also requires the provider to stop generation, stop transmission and remove the content promptly, and to report to the competent authorities.

claims.subject: cn-generative-ai-interim-measures-2023

object.value: Explain training-data sources, scale, types, annotation rules and algorithmic mechanisms to supervising authorities on request

claims.statement: Article 19 of the Interim Measures requires providers to cooperate with supervision and inspection by the competent authorities and, as required, to explain the source, scale and types of training data, the annotation rules and the mechanisms of their algorithms, and to provide necessary technical and data support.

time.note: Dated by Order No. 15.

claims.qualification: A duty owed on inspection, not a duty to publish. Whether any named developer or service falls within the category is set aside.

evidence.passage: 按要求对训练数据来源、规模、类型、标注规则、算法机制机理等予以说明
evidence.translation: as required, give explanations of the source, scale and types of training data, the annotation rules, the mechanisms of the algorithms, and so on

claims.subject: cn-generative-ai-interim-measures-2023

object.value: Penalties under the Cybersecurity, Data Security, Personal Information Protection and Science and Technology Progress laws; otherwise warnings, criticism, orders to correct, suspension

claims.statement: Article 21 of the Interim Measures provides that providers that violate the Measures are punished under the Cybersecurity Law, Data Security Law, Personal Information Protection Law, Science and Technology Progress Law and other laws, and, where the law provides nothing, by warnings, public criticism and orders to correct within a time limit, with suspension of the service on refusal or in serious cases.

time.note: Dated by Order No. 15.

claims.qualification: States the enforcement provision only; no enforcement action is recorded.

evidence.passage: Violations are punished by the competent authorities under the four named laws and other laws and administrative regulations; where these make no provision, the authorities give warnings and circulate criticism, order correction within a time limit, and order suspension of the relevant service on refusal or where circumstances are serious.

claims.subject: cn-generative-ai-interim-measures-2023

object.value: Generative AI service provider: organisations and individuals providing generative AI services, including via programmable interfaces

claims.statement: Article 22, point (2), of the Interim Measures defines a generative AI service provider as an organisation or individual that uses generative AI technology to provide generative AI services, including by providing a programmable interface.

time.note: Dated by Order No. 15.

claims.qualification: Definition only. Whether any named developer or service falls within the category is set aside.

evidence.passage: 包括通过提供可编程接口等方式提供生成式人工智能服务
evidence.translation: including providing generative AI services by means such as providing a programmable interface

evidence.passage: Point (1) defines generative AI technology as models and related technologies capable of generating text, images, audio, video and similar content; point (2) defines the provider as an organisation or individual that provides generative AI services using such technology.

claims.subject: cyberspace-administration-of-china
claims.statement: The Cyberspace Administration of China, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Public Security and the National Radio and Television Administration issued the Measures for Labelling AI-Generated Synthetic Content by a notice (国信办通字〔2025〕2号) dated 7 March 2025.

claims.qualification: Records issuance by the four departments named in the notice; the other three departments are not dataset entities and are named in the statement only.

evidence.passage: 国信办通字〔2025〕2号
evidence.translation: Guoxinban Tongzi [2025] No. 2 (document number)

The news item reports that the four departments recently jointly issued the Measures, effective 1 September 2025.

claims.timelineLabel: China: AI-generated content labelling measures issued
claims.briefQuestion: On what date were China's Measures for Labelling AI-Generated Synthetic Content issued, by which bodies, and of what kind is the date?

claims.subject: cn-ai-content-labelling-measures-2025

object.value: Effective from 1 September 2025

claims.statement: Article 14 of the Labelling Measures provides that they take effect on 1 September 2025.

time.note: Effective date stated in Article 14.

claims.qualification: States the date in the text; implementation is not recorded.

evidence.passage: 本办法自2025年9月1日起施行。
evidence.translation: These Measures take effect from 1 September 2025.

claims.briefQuestion: From what date do China's Measures for Labelling AI-Generated Synthetic Content take effect?

claims.subject: cn-ai-content-labelling-measures-2025

object.value: Applies to network information service providers within the Algorithm Recommendation, Deep Synthesis and Generative AI rules

claims.statement: Article 2 of the Labelling Measures provides that they apply to labelling activities of network information service providers that fall within the situations governed by the Algorithm Recommendation Provisions, the Deep Synthesis Provisions and the Interim Measures on generative AI services.

time.note: Dated by the issuing notice.

claims.qualification: Whether any named developer or service falls within the category is set aside.

evidence.passage: The Measures apply to the AI-generated content labelling activities of network information service providers ("service providers") that meet the situations specified in the three named rules, including the Interim Measures for generative AI services.

claims.subject: cn-ai-content-labelling-measures-2025

object.value: Labels are explicit (perceptible to users) or implicit (embedded in file data)

claims.statement: Article 3 of the Labelling Measures divides labels for AI-generated synthetic content into explicit labels, presented in text, sound or graphics and clearly perceptible to users, and implicit labels, added to the content's file data by technical measures and not easily perceptible.

time.note: Dated by the issuing notice.

claims.qualification: Definitions only.

evidence.locator: Article 3 (第三条), second to fourth paragraphs
evidence.passage: Labels comprise explicit labels (added in the content or the interaction interface, presented as text, sound, graphics and the like, clearly perceptible to users) and implicit labels (added to file data by technical measures, not easily perceptible to users).

claims.subject: cn-ai-content-labelling-measures-2025

object.value: Explicit labels on text, audio, images, video and virtual scenes; downloads and exports to carry them

claims.statement: Article 4 of the Labelling Measures requires service providers whose services fall under Article 17(1) of the Deep Synthesis Provisions to add explicit labels to generated text, audio, images, video and virtual scenes, and to ensure that downloaded, copied or exported files contain the required explicit labels.

time.note: Dated by the issuing notice.

claims.qualification: The category is defined by cross-reference to the Deep Synthesis Provisions, which were not retrieved. Whether any named developer or service falls within the category is set aside.

evidence.passage: 服务提供者提供生成合成内容下载、复制、导出等功能时，应当确保文件中含有满足要求的显式标识
evidence.translation: When service providers offer functions such as downloading, copying or exporting generated synthetic content, they shall ensure the files contain explicit labels meeting the requirements

evidence.passage: The first paragraph specifies placement of explicit labels for text, audio, images, video, virtual scenes and other scenarios, for services within Article 17(1) of the Deep Synthesis Provisions.

claims.subject: cn-ai-content-labelling-measures-2025

object.value: Implicit labels in file metadata with content attributes, provider name or code and content number

claims.statement: Article 5 of the Labelling Measures requires service providers to add implicit labels to the file metadata of generated synthetic content, containing production information including the content's attributes, the provider's name or code and a content number, and encourages digital watermarks.

time.note: Dated by the issuing notice.

claims.qualification: Whether any named developer or service falls within the category is set aside.

evidence.passage: 隐式标识包含生成合成内容属性信息、服务提供者名称或者编码、内容编号等制作要素信息
evidence.translation: the implicit label contains production-element information such as attribute information of the generated synthetic content, the service provider's name or code, and a content number

evidence.locator: Article 5 (第五条), first and second paragraphs
evidence.passage: The implicit label is to be added to the file metadata in accordance with Article 16 of the Deep Synthesis Provisions; providers are encouraged to add implicit labels such as digital watermarks in the content.

claims.subject: cn-ai-content-labelling-measures-2025

object.value: Unlabelled output on user request only after user agreement, with logs kept at least six months

claims.statement: Article 9 of the Labelling Measures allows a service provider, at a user's request, to provide generated content without explicit labels after the user agreement sets out the user's labelling obligations, and requires the provider to keep logs including information on the recipient for at least six months.

time.note: Dated by the issuing notice.

claims.qualification: Whether any named developer or service falls within the category is set aside.

evidence.passage: 依法留存提供对象信息等相关日志不少于六个月
evidence.translation: retain, in accordance with law, relevant logs such as information on the recipient for no less than six months

evidence.passage: The provider may supply content without explicit labels on a user's application, after the user agreement makes clear the user's labelling obligations and responsibility for use.

claims.subject: cn-ai-content-labelling-measures-2025

object.value: Submit labelling materials in algorithm filing and security assessment procedures

claims.statement: Article 12 of the Labelling Measures requires service providers, when completing algorithm filing, security assessment and similar procedures, to provide labelling-related materials under the Measures.

time.note: Dated by the issuing notice.
